requirement: The non-concerning A/B case must not trigger a real Gemma caregiver alert or urgent Hermes handoff when no possible floor-stay event is persisted.

observed_behavior.reason: Case B is a persisted normal/no-event observation check, not a reviewable care event. Real Gemma drafting remains downstream of persisted care events or explicit human/operator input.
